name: Win or Lose Brainrot
desc:
🍀 Welcome to Win or Lose Brainrot! 🍀

Tung Tung Tung Sahur is challenging you! 🫵

How to Play:
• Buy a booster
• Pick a card and avoid bomb
• Win a Brainrot
• Place your Brainrot
• Earn cash
• Unlock powerful mutations

⭐ Remember, your Brainrots keep earning cash even when you’re offline! ⭐

Will you collect all the 244+ unique Brainrots?
